anchors.code_excerpt: definition result equals (newproduct and seeksauthorisation) or existingtokenisation or materialchange
anchors.quote:
For new investment products that have tokenisation features and plan to seek the SFC’s authorisation, prior consultation with the SFC is required.
Prior consultation is also required for tokenisation of existing SFC-authorised investment products and/or material changes to the tokenisation arrangements of tokenised SFC-authorised investment products. Such change(s) may require prior approval8.

assumptions: The supplied boolean `materialchange` already classifies whether the proposal makes a material change to tokenisation arrangements.
The two consultation sentences are implemented as a disjunction: new product seeking authorisation, existing-product tokenisation, or material change.
The output represents prior consultation required and does not represent prior approval.
value.interpretation: Prior consultation is required when either (i) the product is new, has tokenisation features, and SFC authorisation is planned, or (ii) the proposal tokenises an existing SFC-authorised investment product, or (iii) the proposal makes a material change to tokenisation arrangements of a tokenised SFC-authorised investment product. The supplied interface provides these conditions as booleans; no additional source restrictions are available for validation.
